text:
### Business Activities  
**High-Risk Businesses:**
- Money services (remittance)
- Casinos, gambling
- Art dealers, jewelers
- Cash-intensive retail
- Used car dealerships
- High-value goods (watches, handbags)
name: Chunk 8/61

raw_entities.name: Money Services Business Activity
raw_entities.description: Money services and remittance businesses are identified as high-risk activities requiring enhanced AML scrutiny. Staff must recognize customers or account holders engaged in remittance services as presenting elevated compliance risk.

raw_entities.name: Casino and Gambling Business Activity
raw_entities.description: Casinos and gambling operations are flagged as high-risk business activities due to their cash-intensive nature and potential for money laundering. Staff should apply enhanced due diligence to customers involved in this sector.

raw_entities.name: Art and Jewelry Dealer Business Activity
raw_entities.description: Art dealers and jewelers are classified as high-risk businesses due to the high value and portability of goods, which can facilitate money laundering and asset concealment. Enhanced KYC and transaction monitoring apply.

raw_entities.name: Cash-Intensive Retail Business Activity
raw_entities.description: Cash-intensive retail operations present elevated AML risk due to the difficulty in tracing the source and destination of funds. Staff must apply heightened monitoring to customers engaged in this business type.

raw_entities.name: Used Car Dealership Business Activity
raw_entities.description: Used car dealerships are identified as high-risk businesses, typically involving large cash transactions and high-value asset transfers that can mask money laundering activity. Enhanced due diligence is required.

raw_entities.name: High-Value Goods Trade Business Activity
raw_entities.description: Businesses dealing in high-value portable goods such as watches and handbags are flagged as high-risk due to their susceptibility to money laundering through asset purchases and resale. Enhanced monitoring and KYC procedures apply.

properties.description: Money services businesses, particularly remittance operations, present elevated AML risk due to high transaction volumes and cross-border fund movement
Casinos and gambling operations are high-risk due to large cash transactions and potential for money laundering through gaming activities

properties.name: Art and Jewelry Dealer Business Activity

properties.description: Art dealers and jewelers present AML risk due to high-value transactions, subjective pricing, and ease of value transfer
Cash-intensive retail businesses present elevated AML risk due to high volumes of cash deposits and difficulty in transaction tracing
Used car dealerships are high-risk due to significant cash transactions, high-value goods, and potential for structuring
Trade in high-value goods presents AML risk due to large transaction values and ease of value concealment
